title: How Can Frontline Connectivity Build Operational Resilience?
summary: In manufacturing, today’s modern factory floor presents a complex, dynamic environment humming with workers, sensors, and systems. Yet, many manufacturers operate without complete visibility.
body_markdown:
**


**Key Takeaways**


- Seamless frontline connectivity builds resilience by linking edge devices with secure networks to streamline real-time operations.


-


Integrating wearable duress badges with high-priority location services helps protect clinical staff by eliminating search delays during crises.


-


Connecting scanner telemetry to self-healing networks bridges manufacturing visibility gaps, while intelligent location sensing and real-time inventory tracking optimize retail stock and streamline customer fulfillment.


In[manufacturing](https://www.zebra.com/manufacturing) , today’s modern factory floor presents a complex, dynamic environment humming with workers, sensors, and systems. Yet, many manufacturers operate without complete visibility:


-


**Only**[16% of manufacturers](https://www.zebra.com/content/dam/zebra_dam/en/infographic/manufacturing-infographic-vision-study-actionable-visibility-en-us.pdf) currently have real-time monitoring across their entire manufacturing process.


-


To address these efficiency gaps,[61% of manufacturers](https://www.zebra.com/us/en/cpn/in-pursuit-of-excellence.html) expect to implement AI to improve performance, workflows, and maintenance by 2029.


Industry leaders close this "visibility gap" by extending intelligence from the frontline to the core of the network.


Rugged, purpose-built edge devices put AI directly into action, enabling Optical Character Recognition (OCR), image capture, and scanning in existing workflows. Simultaneously, on-device wireless insights capture connection states and roaming performance to give IT teams a device-side view of network health.


By continuously analyzing network telemetry and correlating it with client events in real time, IT teams can pinpoint the root cause of issues immediately, maintaining peak performance across the production line.


## Securing the Healthcare Frontline


In[healthcare](https://www.zebra.com/healthcare) , seconds save lives. Yet, caregivers face unprecedented challenges to protecting their own safety. Caring for others should never compromise personal security, but recent statistics reveal a sobering story:


-


[86% of nurses' associations](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/811075442/on-international-nurses-day-a-new-state-of-the-world-s-nursing-report-charts-a-path-toward-universal-health-coverage) report violence or hostility against nurses from patients or the public.


-


Consequently,[25% of nurses](https://www.zebra.com/content/dam/zebra_dam/en/infographic/healthcare-infographic-zebra-hpe-staff-safety-en-us.pdf) have considered leaving the profession due to workplace violence.


To combat this workforce crisis, care facilities deploy duress alerting systems to help safeguard clinical staff. Purpose-built, rugged wearable badges and mobile computers allow *instant activation* via a simple button press or quiet spoken phrase. Integrated camera capabilities can automatically trigger a live video feed to security, providing invaluable *visual context* so responders know what to expect.


A duress alert performs only as well as the network carrying it. High-priority network connectivity utilizes precise positioning via access points to triangulate where an alert originates, eliminating the need to search entire floors. The network prioritizes duress traffic ahead of routine activity to minimize *delay* , and speed up help.


## Elevating the Retail Experience


Just as connectivity helps protect lives in healthcare and powers productivity in manufacturing, it elevates the modern[retail](https://www.zebra.com/us/en/industry/retail.html) experience. Modern store environments face the challenge of aligning physical foot traffic and omnichannel demand with lean staffing and rapid inventory turnover.


Integrating edge computing, location sensing, and frontline mobile workflows create actionable visibility across retail spaces:


-


**Location Sensing and Geofencing:** Indoor positioning and geofencing alert store associates when curbside pickup customers arrive, expediting handoffs while tracking high-value merchandise across sales floors.


-


**Dynamic Inventory Visibility:** RFID tracking combined with distributed edge processing identifies missing or misplaced stock immediately, enabling timely shelf replenishment and reducing out-of-stock friction.


-


**Automated Task Prioritization:** Context-aware task management systems route prioritized restock and customer assistance alerts straight to associate handhelds, allowing store teams to resolve operational bottlenecks before they affect the shopper experience.
